title: YouTube Tests Hiding the Dislike Button
excerpt: YouTube is reportedly testing the removal or relocation of the video dislike button for some users.
body_html:
YouTube is currently exploring changes to how the dislike button appears on video pages. Recent reports indicate that the platform is testing the removal or relocation of the feature for select users.

According to findings shared online, at least two individuals posted screenshots showing that the dislike button has been moved into the three-dots submenu. Additionally, another user reported seeing the button completely absent from the interface.

These observations suggest that a test is underway, though the company has not made any official announcements regarding a broader rollout or permanent changes to the platform's layout.
